articles.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
articles.description: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.

articles.title: What are perps, anyway? Everything you need to know about crypto’s hottest trading instrument
articles.description: Perps, which launched on BitMEX in 2015, have become one of the most traded financial products in the world.

articles.title: Bitcoin price eyes $66K as US stocks rise on Iran-strike pause
articles.description: Bitcoin copied US stocks as relief over end of US-Iran strikes spread to risk assets at the start of the US trading session.

articles.title: Fanatics buys regulated exchange in bid to grow prediction markets business
articles.description: The deal gives Fanatics control of its own prediction market infrastructure as event-based trading gains traction across sports, finance and crypto.

articles.title: Cantor is advising crypto bank AMINA on path to potential public listing
articles.description: The Swiss bank is exploring multiple paths to the public markets, though discussions are ongoing and no final decision has been made.

articles.title: Lido begins moving $16.5 billion in staked ether to cut validator count by a third
articles.description: The liquid staking protocol is consolidating 8 million ETH and requiring its professional node operators to post bonds for the first time.

articles.title: Hong Kong crypto giant HashKey merges regional exchange into one
articles.description: Hong Kong’s HashKey will unify its crypto exchange branches, with users from its Hong Kong, Global, Singapore and Middle East regions using the same platform.

articles.title: Thailand's SEC alleges Bitkub concealed cyberattack that led to $50 million hack
articles.description: Bitkub was the victim of a cyberattack in May 2021, which led to hacks stealing 1.7 billion baht across 16 different digital assets.

articles.title: Rate path still divides investors: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin traders prepared to navigate a slew of volatility catalysts as US inflation data and US-Iran war triggers keep risk-assets in an unpredictable state.

articles.title: Nvidia forms 37-member AI security alliance without OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
articles.description: The chipmaker and 36 other companies say defenders need AI they can run themselves. Major AI players OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not among them.

articles.title: Binance disappears from Google Play in certain EU countries
articles.description: Binance’s Android app is unavailable on Google Play in some EU markets amid scrutiny over MiCA compliance.

articles.title: USDC issuer Circle to acquire nearly 1,000 IBM blockchain patents
articles.description: IBM’s blockchain portfolio includes more than 680 patent families and nearly 1,000 issued patents worldwide, with a particular focus in supply chain applications.

articles.title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
articles.description: The license broadens the BlackRock tokenization partner's offering as regulators weigh rules for onchain investment products.

articles.title: Crypto is rewriting how Wall Street traders spend their weekends
articles.description: Around-the-clock crypto markets are forcing Wall Street to reevaluate one of its oldest assumptions: that weekends are for waiting.

articles.title: Enigma raises $70M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
articles.description: The massive seed round was led by  Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Sarah Guo's Conviction Partners.

articles.title: Bitmine buys more ether as Tom Lee says rising ETH/BTC ratio points to stronger crypto prices
articles.description: The Ethereum treasury company added nearly 10,000 ETH while expanding its stock buyback, citing ether outperforming bitcoin is sending a bullish signal.

articles.title: Circle buys nearly 1,000 blockchain patents from IBM
articles.description: The portfolio covers blockchain technology, banking, insurance, and cloud security, though the financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

articles.title: Strategy sells MSTR shares, buys back $25M in STRC preferred stock
articles.description: Strategy raised $544.5 million through MSTR stock sales as it repurchased $25 million of STRC shares and expanded its US dollar reserve to $3.75 billion.

articles.title: Michael Saylor's Strategy boosted cash reserve to $3.75 billion, repurchased $25 million of STRC
articles.description: The company last week raised $544.5 million in cash via sales of its common stock.

articles.title: Bitcoin options traders are dropping their hedges going into the Fed meeting
articles.description: The put/call ratio has fallen to about 0.52 from 0.76 in late June, and one-week downside protection has collapsed in price. The options market is positioned for a quiet week that contains an FOMC decision.
